messages:
caroline: Heads-up — trying to onboard a HF chat model with a Jinja-based chat_template and seeing weird role bleed. System prompt seems to vanish when the template uses a macro with a default empty block. Repro below.

rahul: ugh, saw similar once when whitespace-control tags ate a sentinel token. can you paste the template + the converted prompt?

caroline: paste incoming. original HF chat_template: 
```jinja
{% macro user_block(user_name) -%}
{{user_name or ''}}:
{%- endmacro %}

[INST]{{system}}

{{ user_block(user) }}{{ user_message }}
[/INST]
```
converted by hf2rw: 
```text
system: <content missing>
user: Alice:
Hello
assistant: Alice:
...
```
so system line is gone and assistant gets a stray "Alice:" prefix.

eva: can you share the tokenizer/config.json from the model card? sometimes special_tokens and bos/eos flags matter. also any pre/postprocessors the converter applied?

caroline: model repo has minimal config.json: 
```json
{"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "pad_token": null, "add_bos_token": false}
```
and tokenizer has `unk_token` set but no `sep_token`. converter log shows: `Applied jinja prerender -> flattened blocks` then `Mapped role markers -> rw_role_prefix`.

linh: two quick suspects: (1) `add_bos_token` being false can shift how we detect system vs user boundaries in our heuristic, (2) the macro's `-` whitespace control removed the sentinel markers our pre-render step expects.

matt: also check that special_tokens_map in HF repo doesn't alias `system` to something else. our hf2rw converter looks for explicit markers like `[INST]`/`[/INST]` and a fallback that tries to split on lines matching `^System:|^system:` — macros that inline names can confuse that.

caroline: repro pipeline I used: 
```bash
python hf2rw/convert.py --repo ./model --template chat_template.jinja --out converted.txt 2>&1 | tee convert.log
```
convert.log excerpt: 
```
INFO prerender jinja -> applied macro expansion (whitespace-suppressed)
WARN prerender sentinel not found after render; attempting heuristic split
INFO heuristic split: found role-token on same line as user name
```

rahul: ok, concrete fixes: (A) temporarily disable whitespace-trimming in prerender (drop `-` in `{%`/`%}` and `{{-`/`-}}`), (B) add a sentinel explicit in template e.g. `{{ system | default('[SYSTEM]') }}` so it survives, (C) update converter to treat empty system -> preserve an explicit empty system placeholder token instead of dropping the line.

eva: i tried A locally and got preservation of system line but then quant evals show a tiny regression (0.4% exact-match) vs previous conversion. not sure if it's a tokenizer boundary thing. might be tokenization of the inserted sentinel causing subtle context shift.

linh: worth trying B with a sentinel that's a tokenizer-single-token (e.g., use `<|sys|>`) and declare it as a special token in tokenizer.json so token boundaries are stable. that should avoid EM drops caused by tokenization splits.

caroline: tried sentinel `<|SYS|>` and added to tokenizer special_tokens_map, conversion now yields: 
```text
[SYSTEM]<|SYS|>
user: Alice:
Hello
assistant:
...
```
system content still empty but at least present. quantized evals are back to baseline.

matt: long-term we should patch the converter to (1) preserve empty system nodes by injecting a configurable sentinel token, (2) avoid heuristics that split on role names alone, and (3) validate that any injected sentinel is present in model tokenizer (or else warn with a failing healthcheck).

rahul: opened PR with tests: `hf2rw#438` adds sentinel injection and a parity test using vicuna-style templates + macros. test harness runs tokenization diffs and simple lm-eval checks.

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded -> s3://redwood-models/hf2rw/1878001234-conversion/ (size: 2.1MB).

caroline: thanks — next steps for me: (1) run the quantized 4-bit sweep on the sentinel-injected conversion, (2) run eval suites (squad/llm-eval-lite) and report diffs, (3) drop a bake-off in eng-ml channel if any persistent regressions.

eva: ping me once you have 4-bit results, i'll check decoding artifacts and failure cases.

matt: adding a note to onboarding docs: "When converting HF chat_templates that use macros, prefer explicit sentinel tokens and ensure tokenizer special_tokens_map includes them." :memo: :+1:

caroline: cool — will follow up with a short postmortem if we find anything surprising. thanks all!
